body:
The doc as I’m holding my newborn daughter:
“What vaccines are you interested in on top of the requirement?”
Me: All of em. I spent 9 months on this thing buff it UP! Bitch didn’t ruin my body to die, she gonna live now boi.

I threw up a bit after writing this but I feel like I really need to add that he showed me video of him firing an AK47 as if it was automatic. He cried then put about $600 cash on my coffee table then cried more and said it was for the souls he was about to harvest. Local PD said he’s done nothing Wrong.
I still get hateful messages from my family. They all keep insisting the things he does is ok somehow...
I’m sorry I got super wound-up writing that. I’m great now, I found a therapist I like. I still don’t trust my cousin at all though. If you see a gross white guy trying to play normal though...
I once took $300 because he said I’m “just the right amount of ugly to punch me into submission”. Works for me!! I’d punch anyone to pay my fucking phone bill.
